text: {"assertions":["A memory blowup issue in graph/store/adjacency.rs was diagnosed and fixed on 2026-04-22.","The memory problem only manifested when the input list was empty.","The root cause was an off-by-one error in a slice bound.","The symptom was resident memory climbing with each batch during execution.","The fix reduced job execution time from approximately 7 hours to 61 minutes.","A property test was added to the fix to prevent regression of the off-by-one error.","The fix was submitted as PR #1654 on branch fix/memory-blowup-1.","This was the same area of graph/store/adjacency.rs where earlier memory blowup work had been done."]}
